title: thelypteris triphylla var. parishii
intro: Thelypteris triphylla var. parishii, commonly known as the Parish's maiden fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems. The health benefits of Thelypteris triphylla var. parishii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
